name: mantis-cn
title: Mantis cn
description: The class-name helper every Mantis component imports: shadcn's cn, taught Mantis's text styles (text-display-lg, text-title-sm…) so a color class never silently drops them, and its size tokens (h-control, size-icon-md…) so a size passed in replaces the component's own. Installed by the base item.
